main.summary: Defines the shared Roslyn diagnostic descriptors used by both the tool-manifest analyzer and the source generator.

field.name: InvalidToolTypeRule
field.summary: Reports when a type marked for manifest analysis does not derive from KusDepot.Tool.

field.name: UnsupportedGenericToolRule
field.summary: Reports when a generic tool type is marked for manifest analysis.

field.name: AmbiguousMethodNameRule
field.summary: Reports when one tool-operation method name resolves to multiple protected-operation indexes.

field.name: CustomOperationIndexOutOfRangeRule
field.summary: Reports when a custom protected-operation index falls outside the supported manifest range.

field.name: MissingToolSchemaIDRule
field.summary: Reports when a tool manifest declaration omits a required non-empty tool schema identifier.

field.name: SyncAsyncSemanticDriftRule
field.summary: Reports when paired sync and async operation methods appear to describe the same semantic operation but use different protected-operation indexes.

field.name: HandwrittenManifestIndexMismatchRule
field.summary: Reports when a handwritten manifest descriptor publishes the wrong protected-operation index for a real tool method.

field.name: HandwrittenManifestMethodNameMismatchRule
field.summary: Reports when a handwritten manifest descriptor names a tool operation that cannot be resolved.

field.name: InvalidCompanionNamespaceRule
field.summary: Reports when a tool manifest declaration configures an empty or syntactically invalid companion namespace override.

field.name: InvalidAssemblyCompanionNamespaceRule
field.summary: Reports when an assembly manifest declaration configures an empty or syntactically invalid companion namespace override.

field.name: InvalidCompanionTypeNameRule
field.summary: Reports when a tool manifest declaration configures an empty or syntactically invalid companion type-name override.

property.name: All
property.summary: Gets the complete immutable set of shared tool-manifest diagnostic descriptors.
